verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents AgentOS, a toolkit specifically for AI agents to act on production Airwallex accounts (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, etc.), and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at the AgentOS docs page, alongside a separate developer connector for coding agents. This is a financial platform (not itself an agent), so the axis applies and is met by first-party evidence. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice beyond vendor docs.
